info.name: KSP kRPC & kRPC-MechJeb
info.description:
Postman collection for the kRPC Kerbal Space Program remote procedure call API and the kRPC-MechJeb addon.

## Protocol
kRPC communicates via Protocol Buffers over TCP/IP (port 50000) or WebSocket. This collection assumes a thin HTTP proxy that forwards POST requests to the kRPC server.

## Quick start
1. Run KSP with kRPC installed and server running (default port 50000).
2. Start an HTTP proxy (see proxy/README) or set `krpc_host` to a running proxy URL.
3. Run **KRPC Core / Get Services** to verify the connection.
4. Run all requests in **SpaceCenter / Vessel** → **Get Active Vessel** to populate handle variables.
5. Proceed with Control, AutoPilot, Flight, Orbit, or MechJeb folders.

## Encoding
All argument and return values are raw Protocol Buffer encoded bytes, base64-encoded:
- **uint64 handle** — varint encoding of the object handle integer
- **float** — 4-byte IEEE 754 little-endian
- **double** — 8-byte IEEE 754 little-endian
- **bool** — single byte: `AQ==` (true) / `AA==` (false)
- **int32/enum** — varint encoding
- **string** — varint length prefix + UTF-8 bytes

## Common encoded values
| Value | Base64 |
|---|---|
| bool false / int 0 | `AA==` |
| bool true / int 1 | `AQ==` |
| int 2 | `Ag==` |
| int 3 | `Aw==` |
| int 4 | `BA==` |
| int 5 | `BQ==` |
| float 0.0 | `AAAAAA==` |
| float 0.5 | `AAAAPw==` |
| float 1.0 | `AACAPw==` |

## Request/Response shape
```json
// Request
{ "calls": [{ "service": "SpaceCenter", "procedure": "get_ActiveVessel", "arguments": [] }] }

// Response
{ "results": [{ "error": null, "value": "<base64>" }] }
```

## kRPC-MechJeb
Requires the KRPC.MechJeb addon by Genhis (github.com/Genhis/KRPC.MechJeb). All MechJeb requests take the vessel handle as first argument to get a MechJeb controller object, then call methods on that object.

## Version note
Verify procedure names against `KRPC.GetServices()` for your installed version.

variable.description: Active vessel handle (base64 varint) — set by Get Active Vessel
Surface reference frame handle — set by Get Surface Reference Frame
Control handle — set by Get Control
AutoPilot handle — set by Get AutoPilot
Flight handle — set by Get Flight
Orbit handle — set by Get Orbit
Resources handle — set by Get Resources
MechJeb SmartASS handle — set by MechJeb / Get SmartASS
kRPC encoding helper code (injected by collection pre-request script)

exec: 'function kRPC_encodeFloat(v){const b=new ArrayBuffer(4);new DataView(b).setFloat32(0,v,true);return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(b)));}',
'function kRPC_encodeDouble(v){const b=new ArrayBuffer(8);new DataView(b).setFloat64(0,v,true);return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(b)));}',
'function kRPC_decodeFloat(s){const b=[...atob(s)].map(c=>c.charCodeAt(0));const a=new ArrayBuffer(4);new Uint8Array(a).set(b.slice(0,4));return new DataView(a).getFloat32(0,true);}',
'function kRPC_decodeDouble(s){const b=[...atob(s)].map(c=>c.charCodeAt(0));const a=new ArrayBuffer(8);new Uint8Array(a).set(b.slice(0,8));return new DataView(a).getFloat64(0,true);}',
'function kRPC_getResult(res,idx){const r=(res.results||[])[idx||0];if(!r)return null;if(r.error)throw new Error(JSON.stringify(r.error));return r.value;}'

item.name: KRPC Core
item.description: Core kRPC server procedures — server status, service discovery, and client identity.

request.description: Returns the kRPC server status including version and number of RPC calls processed.
Returns descriptions of all available services and their procedures. Use to verify installed services (SpaceCenter, MechJeb, etc.) and their exact procedure names and argument types.
Returns the identifier of the current client connection.
Returns the name of the current client.

item.name: SpaceCenter / Vessel
item.description: Vessel discovery and general vessel properties. Run Get Active Vessel first to populate {{vessel_id}}.

request.description: Returns the currently active vessel handle. Stored in {{vessel_id}}.
Returns a list of all vessels in the game.
Returns the name of the vessel. Requires {{vessel_id}}.
Returns the Mission Elapsed Time (MET) of the vessel in seconds (double).
Returns the total mass of the vessel in kg (float).
Returns the current situation of the vessel (enum VesselSituation: PreLaunch=0, Landed=1, Splashed=2, Flying=3, SubOrbital=4, Orbiting=5, Escaping=6, Docked=7).
Returns the surface reference frame handle for the vessel. Stored in {{surface_ref_id}}. Required by Get Flight.

item.name: SpaceCenter / Control
item.description: Vessel flight control inputs. All requests require {{control_id}} — run Get Control first.

request.description: Returns the Control object for the active vessel. Stored in {{control_id}}.
Returns the current throttle setting (0.0–1.0 float).

Sets the throttle (0.0–1.0). Argument position 1 is a base64-encoded float32. Common values: `AAAAAA==` (0.0), `AAAAPw==` (0.5), `AACAPw==` (1.0). Use the collection pre-request helper `kRPC_encodeFloat(value)` to compute any value.
Returns the current SAS state (bool).
Enables SAS. Use `AA==` for false to disable.
Returns SAS mode enum (SASMode: StabilityAssist=0, Maneuver=1, Prograde=2, Retrograde=3, Normal=4, AntiNormal=5, Radial=6, AntiRadial=7, Target=8, AntiTarget=9).

Sets SAS mode. Argument 1 is a varint enum value. `AA==`=StabilityAssist, `AQ==`=Maneuver, `Ag==`=Prograde, `Aw==`=Retrograde, `BA==`=Normal, `BQ==`=AntiNormal, `Bg==`=Radial, `Bw==`=AntiRadial, `CA==`=Target, `CQ==`=AntiTarget.
Returns whether RCS thrusters are enabled (bool).
Enables/disables RCS. `AQ==`=true (enable), `AA==`=false (disable).
Returns the current landing gear state (bool).
Deploys (`AQ==`) or retracts (`AA==`) landing gear.
Activates the next stage. Returns a list of vessel handles for any new vessels created by staging (e.g., dropped boosters).

item.name: SpaceCenter / AutoPilot
item.description: Stock autopilot (SAS extended) — point vessel at a target pitch/heading/roll. Requires {{autopilot_id}}.

request.description: Returns the AutoPilot object handle. Stored in {{autopilot_id}}.
Engages the autopilot to hold the target pitch/heading/roll.
Disengages the autopilot.
Sets the target pitch in degrees (float). `AADIQg==` = 90° (straight up). Use `kRPC_encodeFloat(degrees)` in pre-request script to compute other values.
Returns the current target pitch setting in degrees (float).
Sets the target heading in degrees (0–360 float). `AAAAAA==` = 0° (North).
Sets the target roll angle in degrees (float). `AAAAAA==` = 0°.
Returns the angle error between current and target orientation in degrees (float). Useful to check if autopilot has locked on.

item.name: SpaceCenter / Flight
item.description: Flight telemetry — altitude, position, velocity, attitude. Requires {{flight_id}}. Run Get Surface Reference Frame then Get Flight first.

request.description: Returns a Flight object relative to the surface reference frame. Stored in {{flight_id}}. Requires {{surface_ref_id}} from Get Surface Reference Frame.
Returns altitude above sea level in meters (double).
Returns mean altitude above sea level in meters (double).
Returns altitude above the ground surface in meters (double). More useful for landing than sea-level altitude.
Returns the vessel latitude in degrees (double).
Returns the vessel longitude in degrees (double).
Returns speed in m/s relative to the reference frame (double).
Returns vertical speed in m/s (double). Positive = ascending.
Returns compass heading in degrees 0–360 (float).
Returns pitch angle in degrees −90 to 90 (float).
Returns roll angle in degrees −180 to 180 (float).
Returns experienced g-force (float).

item.name: SpaceCenter / Orbit
item.description: Orbital parameters. Requires {{orbit_id}} — run Get Orbit first.

request.description: Returns the Orbit object handle. Stored in {{orbit_id}}.
Returns apoapsis altitude above body surface in meters (double).
Returns periapsis altitude above body surface in meters (double).
Returns orbital eccentricity (double). 0 = circular, <1 = elliptical, ≥1 = escape trajectory.
Returns orbital inclination in degrees (double).
Returns orbital period in seconds (double).
Returns time to apoapsis in seconds (double).
Returns time to periapsis in seconds (double).
Returns semi-major axis in meters (double).
Returns current orbital speed in m/s (double).

item.name: SpaceCenter / Resources
item.description: Fuel and resource monitoring. Requires {{resources_id}} — run Get Resources first.

request.description: Returns the Resources object handle for the vessel. Stored in {{resources_id}}.
Returns the names of all available resources (list of strings).
Returns current LiquidFuel amount (float). Argument 1 = `kRPC_encodeString('LiquidFuel')`. Use Get Resource Names to find the exact name for your vessel.
Returns maximum LiquidFuel capacity (float). Argument 1 = `kRPC_encodeString('LiquidFuel')`.
Returns current Oxidizer amount (float). Argument 1 = `kRPC_encodeString('Oxidizer')`.
Returns current MonoPropellant amount (float). Argument 1 = `kRPC_encodeString('MonoPropellant')`.

item.name: MechJeb / Setup
item.description: Get MechJeb controller object handles from the vessel. These must be run before the corresponding MechJeb sub-folder requests. Requires the KRPC.MechJeb addon by Genhis.

request.description: Returns the SmartASS controller handle for the vessel. Stored in {{mj_smartass_id}}.
Returns the AscentAutopilot controller handle. Stored in {{mj_ascent_id}}.
Returns the LandingAutopilot controller handle. Stored in {{mj_landing_id}}.
Returns the NodeExecutor controller handle. Stored in {{mj_node_executor_id}}.
Returns the ManeuverPlanner controller handle. Stored in {{mj_maneuver_planner_id}}.
Returns the RendezvousAutopilot controller handle. Stored in {{mj_rendezvous_id}}.

item.name: MechJeb / SmartASS
item.description:
SmartASS attitude control system. Requires {{mj_smartass_id}} from MechJeb / Setup / Get SmartASS.

SmartASSInterfaceMode enum: Orbital=0, Surface=1, Target=2, Advanced=3, Automatic=4
SmartASSAutopilotMode enum: Off=0, KillRot=1, Node=2, Surface=3, Prograde=4, Retrograde=5, NormalPlus=6, NormalMinus=7, RadialPlus=8, RadialMinus=9, RelativePlus=10, RelativeMinus=11, TargetPlus=12, TargetMinus=13, ParallelPlus=14, ParallelMinus=15, Advanced=16, Automatic=17, SurfacePrograde=18, SurfaceRetrograde=19, HorizontalPlus=20, HorizontalMinus=21, VerticalPlus=22

request.description: Returns the current SmartASS interface mode (SmartASSInterfaceMode enum as varint).
Returns the current SmartASS autopilot mode (SmartASSAutopilotMode enum as varint).
Turns SmartASS off (mode 0 = Off). After changing mode, call SmartASS Update to apply.
Sets SmartASS to Kill Rotation mode (1). Stops all rotation.
Points toward the next maneuver node (mode 2).
Points prograde (mode 4). Interface mode should be set to Orbital (0) first.
Points retrograde (mode 5). Useful for deorbit burns.
Sets the SmartASS interface mode to Orbital (0). Required before using orbital reference autopilot modes.
Applies pending SmartASS mode changes. Argument 1 (resetPID bool): `AQ==`=true resets PID controllers, `AA==`=false preserves them.

item.name: MechJeb / Ascent Autopilot
item.description: Automated launch to orbit. Requires {{mj_ascent_id}} from MechJeb / Setup / Get Ascent Autopilot.

request.description: Returns whether the Ascent Autopilot is currently engaged (bool).
Engages or disengages the Ascent Autopilot. `AQ==`=engage, `AA==`=disengage. Set desired altitude and inclination before engaging.
Returns the target orbit altitude in meters (double).
Sets the target orbit altitude in meters (double). The example value encodes 80,000 m (80 km). Use `kRPC_encodeDouble(meters)` in a pre-request script to set custom altitudes.
Sets the target inclination in degrees (double). `AAAAAAAAAAA=` = 0° (equatorial). Use `kRPC_encodeDouble(degrees)` for other values.

item.name: MechJeb / Landing Autopilot
item.description: Automated deorbit and landing. Requires {{mj_landing_id}} from MechJeb / Setup / Get Landing Autopilot.

request.description: Returns whether the Landing Autopilot is currently engaged (bool).
Begins an untargeted landing — deorbits and lands wherever the trajectory leads.
Begins a precision landing at the position target set in KSP (target marker on map). Requires a target to be set.
Aborts the landing autopilot.

item.name: MechJeb / Node Executor
item.description: Execute maneuver nodes. Requires {{mj_node_executor_id}} from MechJeb / Setup / Get Node Executor.

request.description: Returns whether the Node Executor is currently active (bool).
Executes the next maneuver node in the queue.
Executes all queued maneuver nodes in sequence.
Aborts the currently running node execution.

item.name: MechJeb / Maneuver Planner
item.description:
Plan orbital maneuvers. Requires {{mj_maneuver_planner_id}} from MechJeb / Setup / Get Maneuver Planner.

OperationApoapsis, OperationPeriapsis, OperationCircularize, OperationHohmann, etc. are separate controller types accessed via their own getter procedures.

request.description: Returns the OperationCircularize controller. Use MakeNode on this object to create a circularization burn node.
Returns the OperationHohmann controller for Hohmann transfer planning.
Returns the OperationApoapsis controller for changing apoapsis altitude.
Returns the OperationPeriapsis controller for changing periapsis altitude.
